title: Rustom
desc: Rustom, a naval officer, shares a happy relationship with his wife Cynthia. Soon, he discovers her affair with Vikram, a close friend, and is accused of murdering him.

title: Jodi No. 1
desc: Two friends, Jai and Veeru, hatch a clever plot to deceive Rai Bahadur and rob him. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when they fall in love with Rai Bahadur's daughters.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth fall in love with each other. However, things take a dangerous turn when Ganpat, her brother, does not favour their relationship and plans to kill Siddharth.

title: Vijay The Master
desc: Troubled alcoholic teacher JD goes to work at a juvenile reform school. When he realises a dangerous criminal is using students to cover up his crimes, JD sets out to stop him.
